name: x-post-image-16x9
description: Single-image X post, 16:9 at 1600x900 (inside X's 2:1-3:4 range, so it shows uncropped in the feed; 1600x900 is a working size, unverified). For an episode announcement: the episode still or thumbnail art as a full-bleed image layer, few large words, the subject and the words inside the centre half so the same file survives a multi-image crop. Brand-neutral placeholder. Always pair it with alt text (X limit 1,000 characters).
